### Hawaii Packing List

#### Clothing
- Lightweight swimwear
- Quick-dry shorts and t-shirts
- Lightweight long-sleeve shirts for sun protection
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Sandals for beach
- Rain jacket (for sudden showers)

#### Toiletries
- Sunscreen (SPF 50+)
- Beach towel
- Waterproof phone case
- Reusable water bottle
- Beach umbrella or parasol
- Flip-flops

#### Miscellaneous
- Travel documents (passport, tickets)
- Cash and cards
- Travel insurance documents
- Snorkeling gear (if needed)
- Camera or phone for photos
- Snacks and water for hikes
- First aid kit
